candidate.parity_argument: Same contributions, same per-particle candidate order, same float operations (P1-3 analysis section 2, level A given a certificate). Env-major buckets: the key uses Warp's own hash_grid_index arithmetic and float32 cell_width_inv, the sort is stable over ascending particle ids, and the kernel walks cells x fastest, then y, then z with Warp's x_end clamp, so every particle visits exactly the candidate sequence of hash_grid_query(grid, x_p, 2.4 r, e) on the grouped alias-free grid (CPU test: identical id sequences against a grouped wp.HashGrid for dims (5,5,5), (64,64,32), (7,3,4), also after a rebuild on moved points, which exercises the memset-free key validation). Query shrink: a pair impulse is non-zero only if d - 2r + dt*min(v_rel.n, 0) < 0, i.e. d < 2r + dt|v_rel| <= 2r + 2 dt V when both speeds are <= V; such q lie inside the shrunken box (relative 1e-5 and absolute 1e-7 m slack cover float32 rounding), whose cells are a sub-box of the frozen box since floor is monotone, so the visited candidates form an order-preserving subsequence and every dropped candidate contributes exactly zero, which C1 already skips (a +-0 add is the identity on the impulse). The per-env speed flag is computed every substep in the existing guard pass; a flagged env (any particle faster than V or non-finite) uses the frozen reach. Envs failing the alias certificate still go to the unchanged frozen fallback. CPU evidence (Warp CPU, np.array_equal on every array after every substep against the frozen single solver): heterogeneous block scenes at frozen and forced 5x5x5 aliasing dims with >= 2 non-zero contributions per particle, a full-resolution TRIM substep, an N=3 heterogeneous TRIM cutting sequence, partial reset against frozen_v1, and a necessity test: env particles at 20 m/s stay bitwise with the check, and differ when the speed check is disabled while the shrunken reach is kept. GPU dev: samestate reruns bitwise, s512 N=1 full episode final labels identical to alias_free_v1 (37958 labelled, 332 positive), no guard violations, invalid_reason 0.
candidate.rollback: particle_contact_mode='alias_free_v1' (or the default 'frozen_v1'); both code paths are untouched and byte-identical in behaviour. Inside v2, particle_contact_options={'shrink_speed_m_s': None} turns the query shrink off (env-major buckets only).

threshold.rule: G9:<n>:reset on the per-side medians of reset p95 over all ABBA processes at N. Both sides EXCLUSIVE_GPU: FAIL if C > reset_p95_ratio_max x B + reset_p95_slack_ms. Either side SHARED_GPU (or UNKNOWN): PASS if C <= ratio x B + reset_p95_slack_ms; WARN shared_gpu_reset_bimodality (verdict.warnings, not a failure) if C <= ratio x B + reset_p95_shared_slack_ms; FAIL above that. Reason: on a shared GPU each process settles in a ~1 ms or ~7 ms reset mode independent of the variant (smoke_001: B 1.7 ms vs C 7.1 ms at N=1, reversed at N=2).

limitations: VRAM peak and reset p95 are measured inside the process under test (candidate-reported, not independently verified); env-steps/s comes from the caller's outer clock and is cross-checked against the in-process value
intermediate Native-sample positions are dumped as int8 micrometre deltas to the Native sample (|error| <= 0.5 um, larger or non-finite deltas exact); final states are exact
the evaluator reference arrays (mass, reference positions, stencils) are taken from the WP-17 Native recording
samestate uses the baseline harness helpers (run_p1_3a.load_state / contact_stage) on the solver attributes x, v, code, impulse, stats_sum, stats_max, hash / particle_contact
workload A is reduced fidelity (ideal edge tracking, no robot dynamics, reaction not fed back)

G9:window is measured on the episode-mode runs of the window_check plans (same variants, same seeds, replay from reset), not inside the G9 throughput processes; it gates tool-material contact steps (stats slot 1) and new labels, particle-particle contacts (slot 4) are reported only
performance.phases are in-process step walls (candidate-reported), descriptive only
